authority.reason: The frozen panel outcomes have already been viewed in earlier project rounds. This is a mechanism screen, not a sealed holdout.

frozen_input.folds: calendar-month expanding walk-forward; every fitted target is strictly before the scoring month

objective.primary: scheduled-day portfolio mean after 20 bp round-trip cost
objective.candidate_goal: normally one or two names per session; explicit abstention hypotheses may hold cash
objective.allocation: weights are fixed before target-day outcomes; missing execution remains cash

forbidden: switching L4/L6 on prior market breadth
changing a threshold after reading this run
promoting any retrospective winner to production

scorers.G0: daily-rank Ridge alpha=1 with the 15 base features
scorers.L6: G0 plus no_trade_rate_20, no_trade_rate_60, flat_oc_rate_20, zero_range_rate_20
scorers.normalization: within-session percentile rank separately for each scorer

hypotheses.definition: Top two by the mean within-session percentile across G0, L4 and L6; equal weights.
hypotheses.mechanism: Model averaging should reduce feature-set specification noise.

hypotheses.definition: Top two by the minimum of the three within-session model percentiles; equal weights.
hypotheses.mechanism: A pessimistic score rewards candidates that remain strong under every specification.

hypotheses.definition: Top two by ensemble mean minus 0.50 times cross-model percentile standard deviation; equal weights.
hypotheses.mechanism: Explicit uncertainty penalization should avoid unstable extrapolations.

hypotheses.definition: Order first by the number of models placing the name in their top 20, then by ensemble mean; select two equally.
hypotheses.mechanism: Top-set stability is a rank-robust alternative to relying on one exact ordering.

hypotheses.definition: Use the top two by ensemble mean and allocate in proportion to 1/(0.05 + cross-model percentile standard deviation).
hypotheses.mechanism: Keep diversification while assigning less capital to model-sensitive names.

hypotheses.definition: Use one fully invested name when the ensemble top1-minus-top3 gap exceeds the strictly-prior trailing-60-session median gap; otherwise use the top two equally. Default to two until 20 prior gaps exist.
hypotheses.mechanism: Candidate count should respond to cross-sectional separability, not a fixed rank preference.

hypotheses.definition: Restrict to no_trade_rate_20 at or below the session median and flat_oc_rate_20 at or below the session 75th percentile, then take the top two by ensemble mean.
hypotheses.mechanism: A reliability universe may reduce stale-price and non-execution artifacts.

hypotheses.definition: Exclude pre-open adverse-event flags (downward revision/dividend, external financing, impairment, audit problem, correction or support/adverse conflict), then take the top two by ensemble mean.
hypotheses.mechanism: A technical score may be invalidated by a contemporaneous negative disclosure.

hypotheses.definition: When a TDnet-event name is in the top ensemble decile, allocate 25 percent to the best such event and 75 percent to the best no-event name; otherwise use the best two no-event names equally.
hypotheses.mechanism: Separate event alpha from the broad technical signal without letting sparse events dominate.

hypotheses.definition: Each session regress ensemble mean on momentum-20 rank, ATR rank and prior-close-location rank; select the top two residuals equally.
hypotheses.mechanism: Remove common style exposures and rank idiosyncratic predicted alpha.

hypotheses.definition: Rank ensemble mean - 0.15*ATR percentile - 0.10*OC-volatility percentile + 0.05*OC-mean20 percentile; select two equally.
hypotheses.mechanism: Optimize predicted alpha net of observable intraday risk rather than score alone.

hypotheses.definition: Select the ensemble leader and the highest ensemble name from the opposite half of the session momentum-20 distribution; allocate equally.
hypotheses.mechanism: Diversify latent momentum exposure while preserving one unconstrained leader.

hypotheses.definition: Select the ensemble leader, then choose from ensemble ranks 2-10 by ensemble percentile minus 0.15 times its trailing-60-session OC correlation mapped to [0,1] with the leader; allocate equally.
hypotheses.mechanism: Pair-level diversification may improve tail behavior without discarding predicted return.

hypotheses.definition: Estimate the strictly-prior out-of-sample net20 mean of the daily ensemble top-decile with a zero-mean 50-observation prior; take the ensemble top two only when the posterior mean is positive, otherwise hold cash.
hypotheses.mechanism: Trade only when realised out-of-sample evidence says the current score region clears costs.

hypotheses.definition: Use ensemble top two equally but set total exposure to clip(current top1-top3 gap / strictly-prior trailing-60 gap 75th percentile, 0.25, 1.00); default 50 percent exposure until 20 prior gaps exist.
hypotheses.mechanism: Scale gross exposure continuously with cross-sectional signal strength.

hypotheses.definition: Add 0.05 to ensemble utility for supportive revision/dividend/buyback flags and subtract 0.10 for adverse flags, then select two equally.
hypotheses.mechanism: Use disclosure direction as a bounded overlay rather than a separate event-only strategy.

selection_policy.no_reselection: All sixteen hypotheses are reported. A point winner is descriptive only.
retrospective_shortlist_rule: multiplicity-adjusted one-sided 90 percent lower uplift above zero
selection_policy.forward_action: A mechanism passing all retrospective checks may only become a separately named shadow challenger.
